description: Compress *new* coding context into rolling session memory (Headroom-parity). Already-seen chunks are skipped; when memory grows large it is compacted. Pass only the new dump — not the whole history. Preserve code and facts relevant to the query.

context.description: New context to compress (not previously seen this session)

query.description: The coding task or question (never compressed)

session_id.description: Optional session id for rolling memory (defaults to mcp)

name: compress_context
